text: Maren: chat turns run over the websocket /ws/chat, not HTTP. ASGI instrumentation gives one span per CONNECTION (hours, all turns in one trace, plus a span per streamed send). For sc-403 'one chat turn = one trace' I need one hunk in backend/app/api/ws.py: wrap the per-turn 'await _start_turn(...)' call in chat() with a telemetry helper 'with chat_turn_span(turn):' (new root SERVER span, no-op when telemetry is off), and exclude /ws/chat from the ASGI instrumentation. author: ansel
text: Content stream routing (053 side of the contract): a log record goes to the 7-day Loki stream (index label content="true", retention_stream 168h) iff attribute app.content=="true", OR resource service.name=="claude-code" and event.name in {user_prompt, assistant_response, tool_result, tool_decision, api_request_body, api_response_body} (tool_result/tool_decision carry tool_input/tool_parameters under OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1), OR event.name matches ^gen_ai\. (gen_ai.system/user/assistant/tool.message, gen_ai.choice, gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details). Cost: Claude Code tool_result stats live 7 days in Loki; sprint-2 counts should come from traces/metrics. Nils: set app.content="true" on any backend log with content; event names starting gen_ai. are routed regardless.

author: ansel
text: Export queue: each Alloy exporter has a persistent sending_queue on otelcol.storage.file (named volume alloy-data), sizer=bytes with a per-signal cap (traces 256 MiB, logs 256 MiB, metrics 64 MiB, ~0.6 GiB disk max), retry max_elapsed_time=0s (retry until the backend is back), block_on_overflow=false. When full: Alloy refuses new data for that signal with a retryable error, the sender's SDK drops it, Alloy logs it; senders never block and old queued data still drains first.

author: ansel
text: Grafana: anonymous Admin, login form off, port bound to 127.0.0.1 only, holds no data (provisioning only, dashboards none this sprint). Stamping: service.namespace=wcl-agent, deployment.environment.name=unknown (not dev: Alloy can't know), app.layer=build when service.name=claude-code else runtime, each only when missing. Loki level is not an index label (OTLP severity stays structured metadata, Grafana uses detected_level); index labels are exactly service_namespace, service_name, deployment_environment_name, app_layer, content.

author: ansel
text: Redaction is all OTTL in otelcol.processor.transform (stable) rather than otelcol.processor.redaction (experimental in v1.21: would need --stability.level=experimental). Covers resource, span, span event (Claude Code tool.output is a span event), log attributes, log body (string or map top level) and datapoint attributes. Known keys hashed with SHA256; masks replace the secret part with ***.

author: nils
text: 054 side of the content-stream contract: with OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental (the backend's default) ADK 2.10 emits content as the log event gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details (attributes gen_ai.input.messages / output.messages / system_instructions / tool.definitions); under the stable semconv it would be gen_ai.user.message / gen_ai.system.message / gen_ai.choice. The backend marks every gen_ai.* log event app.content="true" in dev and drops them before export outside dev, so Ansel's ^gen_ai\. rule and the app.content rule agree. Tool I/O and prompts also sit on spans (Tempo): gen_ai.input/output.messages, gcp.vertex.agent.llm_request/llm_response/tool_call_args/tool_response; outside dev these are stripped app-side (ADK leaves a '{}' placeholder).
